mircat.pulse_controls: Visible repetition rate specifies the external T660 clock; pulse width specifies MIRcat optical pulse duration. The T660 electrical TTL width is a separate backend setting.
mircat.internal_rate: Provisional MIRcat internal pair: 2100000 Hz and 142 ns; internal rate must exceed external cadence.
mircat.duty_equation: Both external cadence and internal MIRcat rate times actual MIRcat pulse_width_ns * 1e-9 <= min(0.30, connected_vendor_duty_fraction)
mircat.limits: Retain connected vendor minimum/maximum pulse and current limits; resolve missing pulse values from QCL1 readbacks before applying a pair

sources: references/manuals/T660/Highland Technologies T660 Programming Guide.pdf page 92

t660_1.role: continuous reference/probe/frame-input clock from selected installed settings and readbacks

t660_2.A: one positive Fire command per authorized electrical event
t660_2.B: one positive Q-switch command per authorized electrical event
t660_2.C: negative process trigger at every scan opportunity; inactive high
t660_2.terminal_frame: One additional finite frame with A/B/C/D all disabled; no scan index or spectral trigger. Count against upload capacity and elapsed duration.
t660_2.predivider: selected scan period times selected probe frequency, validated integer against installed readbacks

upload: Use existing T660Service.preload_frame_table; pending-field changes only, STORE acknowledgment progress and cancellation; hold ownership through restoration and preservation.
timing_basis: Programmed edges describe the commanded schedule. Aligned native sample timestamps minus independently observed pump timestamps define reconstruction; T660 nominal insertion delay is not an optical calibration.
stationarity: Retain every declared pre-pump and pump-crossing scan in the finite movie. Reuse compatible unpumped baseline support or acquire it automatically. No separate qualification-train approval or manual acknowledgement is required. Measured incomplete recovery prevents the next equivalent pump.

sample.sample_optical_pump: one when independently observed; electrical sync is labeled separately

pump_blocked.physical_action: Not acquired in the standard sequence without an installed supported blocking mechanism; preserve requested-but-unavailable control metadata

dark.physical_action: Not acquired in the standard sequence without an installed supported dark mechanism; preserve requested-but-unavailable control metadata

forbidden: slowing the scan to fit memory
